# 1ACP

1ACP connects native coding Agents to applications through the Agent Client Protocol.

- Homepage: https://scottzx.github.io/1acp/
- Source: https://github.com/scottzx/1acp
- Public npm package: @1agents/acp-service
- Current source release: __VERSION__
- Service, CLI and SDK documentation: https://github.com/scottzx/1acp/blob/main/packages/service/README.md
- DSH plugin guide: https://github.com/scottzx/1acp/blob/main/packages/dsh-plugin/README.md
- Automation guide: https://github.com/scottzx/1acp/blob/main/docs/activepieces-automation.md
- GitHub releases: https://github.com/scottzx/1acp/releases

Install: npm install -g @1agents/acp-service
DSH: dsh plugin --profile web add @1agents/acp-service
CLI: acp-service --help
Service: acp-service serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 36812 --no-report
SDK exports: @1agents/acp-service/runtime, @1agents/acp-service/flows

Requires Node.js >=22.13.0, the native Agent CLI, its authentication, and its ACP adapter where required.
The CLI, runtime SDK and HTTP/WebSocket service work independently of DSH.
The DSH plugin currently accepts text prompts; native controls depend on the Agent, adapter and account.
A2A task delegation is opt-in and disabled by default. Waking a caller requires its receiving host adapter.
